Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns Amid Exam Irregularities

Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned following widespread allegations of irregularities in national entrance exams. The father of a NEET aspirant who died in Uttar Pradesh's Kheri district stated that no compensation could fill the void left by his son's death. Meanwhile, a social media post by the daughter of an Odisha BJP MP celebrating Pradhan's resignation has caused internal party ire, with her account reportedly deactivated. Home Minister Amit Shah commented that students are more important than any post.
